name: ai-chat-extension
description: A coding agent that plans with you, makes changes you approve, and manages which AI model does what.

commands.title: AI Agent: Add Provider (Gemini, OpenAI, Mistral, Ollama…)

aiChat.reviewEdits.description: Agent and Auto modes apply file edits right away and you review them afterwards (Keep / Undo per change, per file, or all). Turn off to accept each edit before it is written. Commands always ask first.

aiChat.backendUrl.description: Leave empty: the extension starts its own backend. Set a URL (e.g. http://localhost:5036) to use a backend you run yourself.

aiChat.apiToken.description: Only with aiChat.backendUrl: the token that backend expects (Agent:ApiToken). The built-in backend uses a random token automatically.

aiChat.streamTimeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for streaming responses

aiChat.diffViewMode.description: How to display file change diffs

aiChat.backendPath.description: Optional path to a backend executable to start instead of the bundled one (for contributors).

aiChat.defaultProvider.description: Provider used when no model is picked: deepseek, anthropic, or the name of a provider you added. Empty = the first configured.

aiChat.openai.baseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint without /v1: https://api.openai.com, https://openrouter.ai/api, or http://localhost:11434 for a local Ollama (no key needed).
aiChat.openai.baseUrl.deprecationMessage: Use 'AI Agent: Add Provider' instead (supports several providers).

aiChat.openai.providerName.description: Name shown in the model picker, e.g. openai, openrouter, ollama.
aiChat.openai.providerName.deprecationMessage: Use 'AI Agent: Add Provider' instead (supports several providers).

aiChat.openai.models.description: Model ids to offer, e.g. ["gpt-5"] or ["qwen3:14b"] for Ollama. They must support tool calling.
aiChat.openai.models.deprecationMessage: Use 'AI Agent: Add Provider' instead (supports several providers).

aiChat.openai.useMaxCompletionTokens.description: Enable for OpenAI's newer models, which reject max_tokens.
aiChat.openai.useMaxCompletionTokens.deprecationMessage: Use 'AI Agent: Add Provider' instead (supports several providers).

aiChat.providers.description: OpenAI-compatible providers added with 'AI Agent: Add Provider' (keys are in secret storage, not here).

scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
scripts.build:all: npm run webview:build && npm run package
